leakage_results.details: Input feature matrix X cleanly separates 242 pregame features from all 5 targets and all post-game box-score columns.
All 24,848 rows belong to eligible stages (Regular Season, Playoffs, Play-In); 0 Preseason games present.
Verified 317 home openers and 282 away openers have strictly null prior scoring averages (0 current-game leaks).
Pregame features for games 1..6 are 100% invariant to adding games 7..8, mutating future scores, and shuffling input row order.
Standings join strictly enforces standings_date < game_date and rejects same-day and future/end-of-season snapshots.
All 24,848 game rows have unique game_ids, valid win_pct bounds [0, 1], valid rest_days [1, 14], and exact home-away differentials.
Same-day games share identical pre-date feature states (strictly prior_date < game_date); earlier same-date results never leak into later same-date games.
